subject: VkFormat83 independent arch9 encoding and four integration gates
body:
Independent pinned-Mesa source review confirms VkFormat83 is R16G16_SFLOAT (include/vulkan/vulkan_core.h:1927), not a Metal enum. pan_format.c:534 maps PIPE_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT -> RG16F, RG01, linear, vertex-capable. genxml/v9.xml:273 defines RG16F=207; v9.xml:317 defines RGB1=16; pan_format.h:299-307 aliases RG01 to RGB1 and packs order | format<<12 | sRGB<<20. Therefore arch9 fetch hardware format = (207u<<12)|16u = 0x000cf010; byte size=4, from u_format.yaml:1666 channels[F16,F16]. Missing components are zero/one per RG01, not old v6 swizzle.

The arch9 Attribute field Format is bits10..31 (v9.xml:493-509 and existing v9_pack.h:1247-1253). For the current non-instanced 1D attribute setup (type5, attribute_type1, offset_enable1), word0 = 5|16|256|(0xcf010<<10) = 0x33c04115, little-endian bytes15 41 c0 33. Source-derived result only; no build or GPU test performed. Generated pack oracle should compare all32 descriptor bytes in the actual implementation test, rather than treating this expected word as the only oracle.

Coherent implementation needs FOUR existing gates, not only three: air_bridge.rs:180 list [97,100,103,106,109]; vertex_fetch.h:tegu_vertex_format_bytes (currently missing83); vertex_fetch.c:vertex_format; nord2_metal_render.c:resources switch. vertex_fetch.c/h remain unowned: root must assign them before edits. Compute owns bridge and textures owns n2r. Do not relax unrelated offset/stride alignment or range checks based on this one format addition. Tests: exact4byte ending in bounds succeeds and1byte-short fails without output mutation; offset/stride overflow; combined linked metadata [103,83,97,103]; generated arch9 pack oracle; then re-run all12 synthetic-descriptor corpus cases. Keep their inferred descriptor provenance explicit.
